arguments.code:
import json, pandas as pd
j=json.load(open('WHOSIS_000001'))
df=pd.DataFrame(j['value'])
codes={'Brazil':'BRA','China':'CHN','India':'IND','Indonesia':'IDN','Mexico':'MEX','South Africa':'ZAF','Turkey':'TUR'}
x=df[(df.SpatialDim.isin(codes.values()))&(df.Dim1=='SEX_BTSX')&(df.TimeDim.isin([2010,2019,2021]))][['SpatialDim','TimeDim','NumericValue']]
print(x.sort_values(['SpatialDim','TimeDim']).to_string(index=False))
p=x.pivot(index='SpatialDim',columns='TimeDim',values='NumericValue')
p['loss']=p[2019]-p[2021]
p['gain']=p[2019]-p[2010]
p['ratio']=p.loss/p.gain
print(p.to_string())
print(p['ratio'].idxmax())
